independent_calendar_review.interpretation: Period level, class mix and within-period ranking all contribute; no unique causal mechanism or recalibration is identified. M5/M15/H1 also weaken within later months; pooling observations across months is not the only issue.

method: Each F/TF uses the same eligible&mature&allowed{1,4} TRAIN mask, uniform weights summing1, and known-side TRAIN prior. Each128D representation is centered/scaled only on all4096TRAIN rows using the qualified coordinate owner; six coordinate fits. Existing fixedalpha.01 regularized Newton solver includes bias in penalty. Ten independent fits, no HPO; lock all coefficients/coordinates before any LATER decode. This standardization changes the old raw-coordinate regularized objective explicitly.
